cast.name: David Brooks
cast.look: A fifty-something American writer with thinning grey-brown hair, rimless glasses, rumpled navy blazer over an open-collar blue shirt, a slightly stooped, thoughtful posture.

cast.name: Everyman
cast.look: A thirty-something office worker with dark hair in a ponytail, grey hoodie, lanyard around the neck, tired eyes - the listener climbing the first mountain.

cast.name: Leo Tolstoy
cast.look: Leo Tolstoy: an elderly Russian novelist with a long white beard, brown peasant tunic with a rope belt, deep-set sorrowful eyes.

cast.name: William Wordsworth
cast.look: A young William Wordsworth in the 1790s: lanky, dark hair to the collar, olive greatcoat and cream cravat, gazing at the dawn.

cast.name: Kathy Fletcher
cast.look: Kathy Fletcher: a warm middle-aged Washington mother with a short silver-blonde bob, red cardigan and an apron, a ladle in hand.

cast.name: David Simpson
cast.look: David Simpson: a broad, gentle middle-aged man with a grey beard, green flannel shirt, sleeves rolled, sitting at a crowded dinner table.

cast.name: Abraham Lincoln
cast.look: Abraham Lincoln: very tall and gaunt, black frock coat, black bowtie, dark hair and chin beard, a stovepipe hat.

cast.name: General McClellan
cast.look: General George McClellan: a short, proud Union general in a dark blue uniform with brass buttons and a kepi, moustache, chin held high.

cast.name: Luke
cast.look: Luke, a hospital janitor: a quiet man in his forties with a shaved head, pale teal work uniform, a cleaning cart beside him.
